summary: Mercury Cloud (by Cosmic Stack) is the cloud cockpit for the local Mercury Agent CLI. Its Free plan is $0/month with open access — no invite needed — and includes access to free-enabled models. Per the official @mercury__agent announcement, Ox Alpha is available free for coding, complex reasoning, large-context work, and long-running agent workflows; the curator with firsthand access confirms Ox Alpha is free without limit on this tier. The general Free plan publicly lists 5,000 Mercury Credits/month and 1 agent connection; card validation may be required but the plan itself is not charged.
claim_steps: Install the local runtime: npm i -g @cosmicstack/mercury-agent (v1.2.0+ required).
Create a Mercury Cloud account at https://cloud.mercuryagent.sh and choose the Free plan.
Run 'mercury cloud connect' locally to pair your agent.
Use Ox Alpha through the cloud cockpit — free without limit per the provider's announcement.
